description: Signed verdict: is this action (action, amount, currency, counterparty, payment instrument) inside the agent's mandate and is the credential active? Evaluates the reserved mandate fields; lists the fields it did not evaluate.

action.description: Action the agent wants to perform (e.g. pay, order, sign).

counterparty.description: CNPJ, domain or wallet address of the other side.

payment_network.description: Payment network or rail of this operation: visa, mastercard, elo, pix, ...

payment_ref_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex of the payment token reference or PAR used (never a card number); checked against mandate.payment_instruments.

spent_today.description: What this agent already spent today, if you track it (used for max_per_day).

name: kya_check_action
